title: 960. Delete Columns to Make Sorted III

examples.explanation: After deleting columns 0, 1, and 4, the final array is strs = ["bc", "az"]. Both these rows are individually in lexicographic order (ie. strs[0][0] <= strs[0][1] and strs[1][0] <= strs[1][1]). Note that strs[0] > strs[1] - the array strs is not necessarily in lexicographic order.
If we delete less than 4 columns, the only row will not be lexicographically sorted.
All rows are already lexicographically sorted.
